External virtual account funded. Emitted when a virtual account assigned to a
customer receives a deposit from outside the CrowdSplit platform. Payload
identifies the receiving customer and the funding amount. This does not by
itself credit a wallet — use `external.deposit.*` events for the subsequent
credit lifecycle.
